text:
Maya (CS): Kestrel preview enrollment update — quick sync. They've accepted seats for 3 teams but security is gating via SSO + data governance. @jamal can you confirm next-week enablement slots? tagging @nora for renewal risk scoring.

Jamal (CS): I can take enablement Thu 9am PT or Fri 1pm PT. Which works for them?

Raj (Kestrel): Thu 9am PT works. On SSO: our security lead wants SCIM + a short SOC2 addendum. Who can own the addendum + checklist?

Sean (Solutions Eng): I can own the SCIM doc + demo. I'll prep a runbook and an integration checklist (small hands-on).

Maya (CS): Awesome. Raj, can you invite their security folks to Thu slot? Also can you drop any sample audit requirements here? We’ll add to the pre-read.

Raj (Kestrel): Putting in invite now. Attaching a quick list of questions they provided: 1) retention windows 2) KM integration (KMS/HSM) 3) audit/logging retention. Will upload their doc in a bit.

Nora (PM): For renewal risk I'm marking this as *medium* for now since security review is gating onboarding. If SCIM + addendum complete within 2 weeks, we can move to *low*. I'll add a follow-up in the cohort tracker and create a 2-week check task.

Jamal (CS): Enablement agenda draft: 1) 15m intro & goals 2) SCIM walkthrough + demo 3) onboarding playbook (roles & runbooks) 4) Qs and next steps. Anything to add?

Maya (CS): Please add a short section on rate limits, prefix/KV caching, and token quota handling — they specifically asked about burst behavior.

Sean (Solutions Eng): I'll cover caching & quotas. Pre-meeting snippet to share as pre-read:

```
# sample runtime settings
team_quota: 2000rpm
kv_cache_ttl: 10m
max_prefix_cache: 8
```

Maya (CS): Perfect. Raj — we'll share the invite + 1-page pre-read. Can you confirm attendees by EOD Wed so we can lock the agenda?

Raj (Kestrel): Confirmed — security lead, infra ops, and product manager will attend. Sending their audit doc now.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Kestrel Preview Enablement — SCIM + Onboard" Thu 2026-06-18 09:00 PT. :calendar:

Maya (CS): :thumbsup: thanks all. Nora — tagging you for the 2-week renewal follow-up. Jamal/Sean — I'll share the recording & enablement checklist after the session.

Nora (PM): Got it. I'll add a renewal touch in 14 days and link this thread.

Maya (CS): Quick risk note: if audit doc requires custom contract terms >3 days to legal review, escalate to AM for renewal cadence adjustment.

Jamal (CS): Noted. I'll prep the checklist and drop in #customer-success-resources after the call.

Sean (Solutions Eng): I'll upload the SCIM runbook + demo slides to the shared drive and post link here.

Raj (Kestrel): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.
